page_title: LIV 1-2 MNU | Liverpool v Manchester Utd 19/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) commits a foul and Michael Oliver immediately signals a free kick.
90+6' Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
90+3' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
90+2' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
90' The fourth official shows 8 min. of added time.
90' Liverpool fail to score from a corner as Senne Lammens (Manchester United) leaps to collect the ball.
90' Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. Liverpool win a corner.

87' What an opportunity! Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes just wide of the left post!
85' Here's the change. Mohamed Salah leaves the pitch and Jeremie Frimpong (Liverpool) comes on as a substitute.
85' Here is a change. Luke Shaw is going off and Ruben Amorim gives the last tactical orders to Leny Yoro (Manchester United).
85' Substitution. Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Bruno Fernandes walks off.

84' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Harry Maguire (Manchester United) bravely launches himself at a cross from Bruno Fernandes and gives Giorgi Mamardashvili no chance with a close-range bullet header into the bottom left corner. 1:2.
84' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
83' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
83' Matheus Cunha (Manchester United) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender. Manchester Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.
80' Michael Oliver blows his whistle and it's Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.

78' 1 - 1 Goal! Federico Chiesa manages to prod the ball to Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) after a melee inside the box, and he needs no second invitation to slot the ball into the left side of the goal. 1:1.
77' Liverpool work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
77' The resulting corner from Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) is cleared by the defence. Now Liverpool have a corner.
77' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. It will be a corner kick for Liverpool.

76' Senne Lammens makes a brilliant save! Curtis Jones (Liverpool) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His effort goes towards the bottom left corner but is saved by the keeper!
75' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Mohamed Salah, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
73' The linesman raises his flag. Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United) is adjudged offside.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Federico Chiesa (Liverpool) replaces Alexander Isak.
69' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) finds some space on the edge of the box after some nice individual play and curls a shot in on goal, but the ball flies just wide of the right post.
68' Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Bruno Fernandes, who fails to shoot.
66' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

66' A lofted cross from Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee signals a corner kick to Manchester Utd.
65' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) pounces on a great cross inside the box, but lashes his powerful first-time shot a whisker past the right post.
64' Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) nutmegs the defender on the edge of the box and lashes in a shot at goal that flies high over the bar.
63' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
62' It's time for a substitution. Curtis Jones (Liverpool) comes on in place of Ryan Gravenberch.
62' Arne Slot has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Florian Wirtz (Liverpool) replacing Conor Bradley.
62' Substitution. Hugo Ekitike (Liverpool) has come on for Alexis Mac Allister.
61' Today's match ends for Mason Mount who will be replaced by Benjamin Sesko (Manchester United).
61' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) makes some space for himself and from mid-range let's fly with a wild effort which goes high over the crossbar.
59' Ruben Amorim has decided to substitute Amad Diallo and he is replaced by Patrick Dorgu (Manchester United).
58' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Casemiro (Manchester United) leaves the pitch to be replaced by Manuel Ugarte.
57' Looks like Casemiro (Manchester United) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
57' Michael Oliver shows a yellow card to Casemiro (Manchester United) for his blatant foul.
55' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is penalised for a foul. Michael Oliver had a clear view and blows his whistle.
55' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) will take the corner.

55' Alexander Isak (Liverpool) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Liverpool will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
54' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) gets to the ball from the resulting corner but blazes it well over the bar.
54' Corner kick. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is ready to send the ball into the box.

53' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender. Liverpool have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
52' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Amad Diallo (Manchester United) was quite harsh and Michael Oliver didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
52' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
51' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
50' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) hit the right post with his blast from close range after receiving a cross from the resulting free kick.
49' It seemed like Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.

49' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Michael Oliver no option but to blow his whistle. Liverpool earn a free kick.
48' The free kick is taken by Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United), but ball is cleared.

47' The game is interrupted. Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. Manchester Utd are awarded a free kick.
46' Referee Michael Oliver blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+4' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Michael Oliver who sees an offensive foul.
45+2' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
45+2' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. The ball is out of play and Liverpool manage to earn a corner.
45+1' Good defending. Conor Bradley (Liverpool) tries to find Dominik Szoboszlai inside the box, but the pass is cut out. The ball is out of play. Liverpool will have a throw-in.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
42' Excellent touch by Matheus Cunha (Manchester United)! He latches on to a precise pass on the edge of the box and produces a shot goalwards which goes way wide of the left post.
41' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.
40' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) takes the corner which is cleared. The ball is out of play. Manchester Utd will have a chance to score from a corner.
40' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared. The ball goes out of play. Manchester Utd are awarded a corner kick.
39' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) rises above the defenders and places a towering header towards the left post, but Senne Lammens is prepared and dives to thwart him.
39' Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
38' The free kick is delivered by Dominik Szoboszlai (Liverpool) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.

35' Excellent touch by Alexander Isak (Liverpool)! He latches on to a precise pass deep into the box and produces a low drive towards the right post. The goalkeeper pulls off a beautiful save to deny him.
33' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the right post is denied by a decent save from Senne Lammens.
32' Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) attempts to find Alexander Isak, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
29' Wasted effort! Alexander Isak (Liverpool) drives to the edge of the box after picking up a rebound, but his shot is tame and bends well wide of the left post.
27' Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Giorgi Mamardashvili.
27' Mason Mount (Manchester United) latches on to an accurate pass inside the box and immediately unleashes a shot towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
24' Bruno Fernandes (Manchester United) storms into the box to get on the end of a pass, but smashes his shot straight onto the right post. Unlucky!
21' Cody Gakpo (Liverpool) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the outside of the right post.

18' Conor Bradley (Liverpool) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Liverpool.

14' Virgil van Dijk (Liverpool) creates himself some space in front of goal and connects with the resulting free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the right post and behind for a goal kick.
13' It seemed like Mohamed Salah (Liverpool) was going to take a quick free kick, but instead he is going to send the ball inside the penalty box for his teammates.
13' Matthijs de Ligt (Manchester United) probably handled the ball. That's a free kick to Liverpool.
10' Ryan Gravenberch (Liverpool) passes the ball onto Milos Kerkez, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
10' Michael Oliver blows his whistle as Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
7' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Cody Gakpo (Liverpool).
6' The foul by Mason Mount (Manchester United) was seen by Michael Oliver who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
5' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
2' Alexis Mac Allister (Liverpool) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
2' 0 - 1 Goal! Amad Diallo plays a pass to the feet of Bryan Mbeumo (Manchester United), and he shoots inside the right post from inside the box. It's 0:1.
1' The match has just started.
Manchester Utd will kick the game off.
Michael Oliver is introduced as the referee for today's match.
